forkChangesPreserved: The composer toolbar fade continues to blend into T3 Pretty’s World Scenery sheet surface rather than reverting to the parent’s former hard-coded gray palette.
upstreamChangesIntegrated: Fade colors now derive directly from the active --color-sheet theme token, allowing custom and future themes to work without hard-coded light/dark RGBA values.
The transparent gradient endpoint now uses themeColorWithAlpha(sheetColor, 0), preserving the sheet color channels while applying transparency.
